title: BILLIONAIRE MAP
outro:
Follow for the money
nobody explains.
vo: Where are the world's billionaires actually made? In twenty ten, America had four hundred. China had sixty-four. Then China's boom minted new billionaires faster than anywhere in history, nearly catching the US. But after twenty twenty-one, Beijing cracked down, and the numbers fell. Meanwhile India quietly rises. America still leads, but the map of money is shifting east.
